scripts.build-native: pkg package.json --compress GZip --public-packages "*" --public --no-bytecode --target node18-win-x64 --output dist/uploader-win.exe && pkg package.json --compress GZip --public-packages "*" --public --no-bytecode --target node18-macos-x64 --output dist/uploader-macos && pkg package.json --compress GZip --public-packages "*" --public --no-bytecode --target node18-linux-x64 --output dist/uploader-linux
scripts.build-docker: docker build -t uploader-builder . && docker run --rm -v $(pwd)/dist:/usr/src/app/dist uploader-builder
scripts.build: npm run build-native && npm run build-docker
scripts.package: npm run clean && npm run build
